source_excerpt:
Sales Executive – Destination Expert (International Holidays)
See who Catch a Trip has hired for this role
Experience: 2–4 years in International Holiday Package Sales
Work Mode: Full-Time, On-site (No Work From Home)
Catch A Trip specializes in customized international holidays, luxury getaways, honeymoons, and personalized travel experiences. We create memorable journeys tailored to every traveller’s preferences, budget, and travel style.
Handle international holiday enquiries from consultation to booking confirmation.
Design customized itineraries for luxury holidays, honeymoons, family vacations, and FITs.
Understand client preferences, budgets, and travel expectations.
Handle premium and HNI clients with personalized service.
Prepare quotations and recommend suitable hotels, activities, transfers, and experiences.
Follow up on leads, negotiate, close bookings, and achieve sales targets.
Maintain CRM records and coordinate with hotels, DMCs, and operations teams.
Build lasting client relationships to generate repeat bookings and referrals.
2–4 years of proven experience in international holiday package sales.
Strong knowledge of European destinations, especially Switzerland, France, Italy, Spain, and Scandinavia.
Experience handling premium clients and high-value bookings.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and sales-closing skills.
Hands-on CRM experience and an understanding of pricing, margins, and profitability.
Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati or Marathi is an added advantage.
A proactive, organized, and target-driven approach to sales.
Work with premium travellers and exciting international destinations.
Gain exposure to luxury holidays and high-value travel experiences.
Earn performance-based incentives and grow with a rapidly expanding travel brand.
Explore career growth opportunities toward Senior Destination Expert, Team Lead, or Sales Manager roles.
Ready to turn travel dreams into memorable journeys?
Join Catch A Trip and build your career in international holiday sales.
Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Catch a Trip by 2x
